text: Deut. 10. 12. , Heb. humble thyselfe to walke.
Or, thy name shall see that which is.
Or, is there yet vnto euery man an house of the wicked? &c. , Heb. measure of leannesse.
Or, shall I be pure with, &c.
Or, he doth much keepe the &c. , 1.Kin. 16. 25, 26. , 1. Kin. 16. 30, &c. , Or, astonishment.
